# Only the order of change shows

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

A stuttering (Stutter ρ) has ρ 0 = 0, each step idle (ρ (n+1) = ρ n) or moving by one, and every step reached; it is read with Sampling's sample. At an idle step nothing takes part: balance, dissipation and closure hold on every family, and running down on a family holding what stands (Flow.sample_idle_balancesOn and others); at a moving step each holds exactly where it holds across the step read (Flow.sample_moves_balancesOn_iff and others). So a world read through a stuttering meets the premises exactly where it meets them (World.stutter_premises_iff): balance (each relatum listed once at each step), dissipation, only active relata giving, only active relata taking, activity needing support, embodiment and bounded transmission; unlike a coarser reading, no condition on how activity is held is needed. Over any stretch the totals are those of the stretch read (stutter_total; Flow.stutter_taken, Flow.stutter_given, stutter_risen, stutter_fallen, stutter_rise_count, stutter_fall_count, and where decided stutter_comings, stutter_ceasings); arising, ceasing and change of standing recur exactly where they recurred (World.stutter_arisingRecurs_iff, World.stutter_ceasingRecurs_iff, World.stutter_change_recurs_iff); a census survives a stuttering (World.sample_counted) and returns where a step of the reading is given for each step (World.stutter_counted_of_section). What a stuttering changes is what is counted per step: with idle steps arbitrarily late no flow is more without end (Flow.sample_not_more); the expansion is more without end and, every step read twice, it is not (Expansion.more_step_relative); a world carried by a reserve of one needs a reserve of at least two when every step is read twice (Lapse.reserve_step_relative). Removing idle steps is a construction: given for each step read the moving step reading it (Stutter.Moves; each exists, Stutter.crosses, and is unique, Stutter.moving_unique) and the idle steps of the world empty and unmoved (World.IdleAt), the world without them (World.withoutIdle) meets every premise exactly where the world does (World.withoutIdle_premises, World.withoutIdle_transmits), with no condition on listing since each step keeps its own exchange, has a census exactly where it does (World.withoutIdle_counted), and over any stretch has the same totals taken and given, rises and falls of a family's standing and their counts (World.withoutIdle_totals), and where activity is decided the same counts of arising and ceasing (World.withoutIdle_counts). No premise.

Canonical source: [Stuttering.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Stuttering.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The stuttering ρ is a given reading; World.withoutIdle constructs the world with idle steps removed from supplied moving steps σ, with preservation proved under Stutter.Moves ρ σ and World.IdleAt.
- The taken and given totals for inserting a stuttering require each relatum listed once; the withoutIdle removal totals require no such condition. Counts of arising and ceasing require activity decided.
- Removing idle steps takes the moving step reading each step as a supplied function σ (Stutter.Moves); each moving step exists and is unique, but this module does not construct that function from the stuttering alone.

P78 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: the zero-premise plan lists a shared discrete index of steps among the commitments of the representation, to be re-founded as P69 re-founded the starting point. This gives the converse of Sampling's strictly increasing reading: inserting idle steps. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): for the laws of one step, the totals and counts over a stretch, and recurrence, the step index carries nothing beyond the order of change; an idle step shows nothing; what is counted per step is relative to the unit of the reading, as with coarser steps. See the integration document §102.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). - Read with every step twice, the expansion is no longer more without end (Expansion.more_step_relative), and the reserve must double (Lapse.reserve_step_relative).
